name: Mechanarium
summary:
Turn your space into a mechanical workshop.

Explore 40 moving exhibits in a glass honeycomb gallery. Open a machine beside you and turn its brass wheel to drive the motion. Discover differentials, planetary gearsets, harmonic and cycloidal reducers, walking linkages, engines and a five-bar parallel robot.

BUILD THE EXHIBITS
